title: Quant'hai lass'il morir (Verdelot)
desc: Philippe Verdelot, Quant'hai lass'il morir. 5 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor I, Tenor II, Bassus), each on its own staff. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
